Location: Goa, India Mode of Work: Remote Brief Overview of the Job Description: As a Freelance Recruiter at Mhymatch, you will be responsible for sourcing, identifying, and hiring top talent for our clients. You will work closely with hiring managers to understand their needs and provide suitable candidates.

Your role will involve managing the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, resume screening, interviewing, and coordinating with candidates. Your success will be measured by your ability to fill positions promptly and effectively, contributing to Mhymatchs growth and success.

Key Responsibilities: Maximize Placement Revenue : Achieve high placement rates to ensure maximum commission revenue for Mhymatch. Budget Management : Efficiently manage recruitment budgets and ensure cost-effective hiring solutions.

Client Satisfaction : Build strong relationships with clients to understand their hiring needs and deliver candidates that meet their requirements. Candidate Experience : Ensure a positive experience for candidates throughout the recruitment process to maintain a strong employer brand.

Sourcing Strategy : Develop and implement effective sourcing strategies to attract top talent using various channels (e.g., job boards, social media, referrals). Applicant Tracking : Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all recruitment activities in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

Compliance : Ensure all recruitment activities comply with relevant laws and regulations. Continuous Improvement : Stay updated with the latest recruitment trends and best practices to continuously improve the recruitment process.

Training & Development : Participate in training sessions and professional development opportunities to enhance recruitment skills. Knowledge Sharing : Share insights and knowledge with the recruitment team to foster a collaborative and innovative environment.

Technologies to be Used: Applicant Tracking System (ATS) LinkedIn Recruiter Job boards (e.g., Indeed, Monster) Social media platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Facebook) Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 3 to 8 years of experience in recruitment or a related field.

Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of recruitment processes and techniques. Familiarity with various sourcing tools and platforms. Understanding of employment laws and regulations. Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Proficient in using recruitment software and tools.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks. Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented mindset. High level of professionalism and integrity. Strong commitment to delivering quality service. Positive and collaborative attitude. Work Environment: Dynamic and fast-paced remote work environment. Supportive and collaborative team culture.

Opportunities for professional growth and development. Key Performance Indicators: Number of successful placements. Time-to-fill metrics. Client satisfaction scores. Candidate satisfaction scores. Compliance with recruitment processes. Salary and Benefits: Compensation: 15% of the commission that Mhymatch will get from successful placements.

Flexible working hours. Opportunity to work remotely. Company Overview: Mhymatch is the worlds first AI full stack recruiter, dedicated to connecting top talent with exceptional opportunities. Our mission is to provide high-quality recruitment services that meet the unique needs of our clients.

We value integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to excellence in all that we do. At Mhymatch, we believe in fostering a supportive and collaborative environment where our team members can thrive and grow. Originally posted on Himalayas

A dedicated Sourcing & Recruitment Coordinator handles sourcing, candidate emails, and scheduling — so your day is spent on what requires real judgment: reviewing, interviewing, and endorsing. You'll work directly with our Senior Manager, Global Talent Acquisition, and grow through weekly coaching. What You'll Do:
Review. Evaluate video introductions and role-specific assessments to decide who moves forward — quickly and fairly.
Interview. Conduct up to 10 interviews per day (30 minutes each, 5 hours of interviewing daily) with the preparation and focus each candidate deserves.
Write. Produce clear, honest interview notes and candidate profilers that hiring leaders can act on the same day.
Endorse. Put your best candidates forward to Ops Leads and Executives with conviction and evidence.
Source. Contribute sourcing efforts on top of the coordinator's pipeline — your network and eye for talent add a second layer to our search.
Calibrate. Attend weekly coaching, team meetings, and calibration sessions, and send a daily end-of-day report on your pipeline.

2+ years of talent acquisition experience
Strong interviewing skills — you can run a tight 30-minute interview that gets past rehearsed answers.
Excellent written English — your profilers and interview notes represent us to leadership.
Stamina and structure — 10 interviews a day is focused work, and you know how to protect your energy and quality across all of them.
Comfortable working US hours, with flexibility across regions.
Bonus: experience hiring for operations or software engineering roles; experience in the US, Philippines, or Latin America markets.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally.
This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally.
You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization.

Technical Recruitment Leadership
Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions.
Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring requirements, interview strategies, talent profiles, and workforce planning priorities.
Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, talent mapping, compensation insights, and hiring recommendations.
Drive recruitment outcomes for complex, senior, niche, and business-critical technical positions globally.
Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage top passive talent across competitive international markets.
Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence
Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring needs.
Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.
Stay current on technical hiring trends, market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability across key regions.
Team Development & Process Excellence
Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing capability, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management effectiveness.
Establish and continuously improve recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, interview calibration standards, and hiring best practices.
Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.
Contribute to the growth and development of the global Talent Acquisition team as the organization scales.
Recruitment Operations & Reporting
Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.
Track key recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and hiring quality.
Ensure a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Support compliance with local hiring regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.
The Right Fit Has
5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with significant exposure to technical hiring.
Proven track record recruiting for Software Engineering, Product Management, Data Science, AI/ML, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or related technical functions.
Demonstrated success hiring senior and difficult-to-fill technical positions in competitive talent markets.
Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.
Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
Strong understanding of technical talent markets, technical role requirements, and engineering organizational structures.
Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data, insights, and market expertise.
Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.
Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.
Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.
Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently delivers high-quality technical hires across multiple functions and regions.
Builds strong, sustainable talent pipelines for critical technical roles.
Serves as a trusted hiring partner to technical leaders and executives.
Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.
Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.

Above-market remuneration.
Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.
High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.
Opportunity to build world-class technical teams globally.
Exposure to complex international hiring across multiple markets.
Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.
Meaningful work that directly contributes to the future of technology and AI-enabled products.

Hypertrics ist eine wachstumsstarke HR-Tech-Plattform mit Sitz in Essen, die mittelständische Unternehmen und Konzerne bei der zielgerichteten, nachhaltigen Besetzung offener Positionen unterstützt – vom Fachspezialisten bis zur Führungsebene.

End-to-End Recruiting: Vollständige, eigenverantwortliche Abwicklung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses – von der Mandatsaufnahme und Anforderungsanalyse über Active Sourcing, Kandidateninterviews und Eignungsbewertung bis zur Präsentation beim Kunden und finalen Einstellung
Active Sourcing: Proaktive, zielgruppengerechte Kandidatenansprache über LinkedIn, XING und weitere relevante Kanäle – strategisch, verbindlich und mit einem klaren Blick für Potenziale
Mandatssteuerung: Eigenständige Steuerung eigener Suchmandate in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Kunden – mit vollem Überblick über Timelines, Kandidatenstatus und Abschlusswahrscheinlichkeit
Kandidatenbetreuung: Professionelle, empathische Begleitung der Kandidaten durch den gesamten Prozess – als verlässliche Ansprechperson bis zur erfolgreichen Vertragsunterzeichnung
Stellenanzeigen & Sourcing-Strategien: Entwicklung zielgruppenspezifischer Sourcing-Strategien sowie Erstellung, Schaltung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Stellenanzeigen
Strukturaufbau: Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Recruiting Unit – inklusive Methoden, Prozessen und operativem Know-how
Ihr Profil
Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung oder Studium – idealerweise mit Bezug zu Personal, Vertrieb oder Kommunikation
Berufserfahrung: Erste bis mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung im Recruiting ist zwingend erforderlich – idealerweise aus einer Personalberatung, Headhunting-Agentur oder Personaldienstleistung; du weißt, wie Direktvermittlung funktioniert, kennst den Druck hinter Mandaten und bringst das nötige Handwerk mit
Prozessverständnis: Du hast den vollständigen Recruiting-Zyklus bereits eigenständig durchlaufen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über Active Sourcing und Interviews bis zur Kandidatenpräsentation und Abschlussbegleitung
Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse – souveränes, überzeugendes Auftreten auf allen Ebenen und in jeder Gesprächssituation
Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, präzise und mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Verbindlichkeit – auch bei parallelen Mandaten behältst du den Überblick
Persönlichkeit: Kontaktfreudig, eigenverantwortlich und mit echter intrinsischer Motivation – du treibst Prozesse aktiv voran, anstatt auf sie zu warten
Ihre Vorteile
Gestaltungsverantwortung: Echter Handlungsspielraum und volle Eigenverantwortung von Tag eins – keine starren Prozesse, sondern unternehmerisches Denken auf allen Ebenen
Erholungszeit: 30 Urlaubstage für eine nachhaltige Work-Life-Balance
Flexibilität: Homeoffice-Optionen für eine moderne, selbstbestimmte Arbeitsgestaltung
Ausstattung: MacBook Air und iPhone – professionelles Equipment für einen professionellen Arbeitsalltag
Gesundheit: Private Krankenzusatzversicherung mit 600 € jährlichem Budget
Entwicklung: Interner Mentor und Trainer für Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld
Unternehmenskultur: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Wertschätzung – in einem Team, das Leistung sieht und honoriert

About the Role The Recruiting Coordinator plays a key role in delivering an exceptional candidate experience while supporting the day-to-day operations of Matter Health 's Talent Acquisition team.

This role serves as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, coordinating interviews, managing recruiting logistics, and ensuring every interaction reflects Matter Health 's values.

In addition to interview coordination, the Recruiting Coordinator partners closely with recruiters by assisting with candidate sourcing, application management, recruiting operations, onboarding coordination, and other Talent Acquisition initiatives.

This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, enjoys building relationships, and is looking to grow a long-term career in Talent Acquisition. What You'll Do
Coordinate interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview teams.
Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process.
Prepare interview confirmations, schedules, and candidate communications.
Maintain accurate candidate information within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Assist recruiters with candidate sourcing, application review, and candidate outreach.
Support job postings, recruiting events, employer branding initiatives, and recruiting projects.
Coordinate onboarding activities and partner with Human Resources to ensure a smooth new hire experience.
Help maintain recruiting reports, pipeline activity, and Talent Acquisition metrics.
Build strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders while delivering an outstanding candidate experience.

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred.
1+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent acquisition, human resources, scheduling, or a related administrative role.
Experience supporting recruiting, sourcing candidates, or coordinating interviews preferred.
Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, or similar recruiting tools preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Passion for delivering an outstanding candidate experience while supporting a growing Talent Acquisition team.
This is a hybrid based role where you'll spend 3 days in office and 2 days remote

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Unternehmen im Bereich Fracht- und Lagerlösungen und optimiert Prozesse rund um Warentransport und -verteilung.
Als Operations Recruiter gestalten Sie aktiv mit, wie ein Unternehmen wächst – denn ohne die richtigen Menschen an Bord bleibt jede Wachstumsstrategie nur Theorie. Sie sind die Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und Talenten, verstehen die operativen Herausforderungen im Detail und finden genau die Persönlichkeiten, die diesen Bereich voranbringen. Kein Recruiting von der Stange, sondern echtes Verständnis für Prozesse, Teams und Menschen.
Wenn Sie gern eigenverantwortlich arbeiten, ein Gespür für Menschen haben und dabei sein wollen, wenn Teams entstehen, die den Unterschied machen – dann ist diese Rolle genau richtig für Sie.
Aufgaben
Mit klarem Fokus auf gewerbliche Mitarbeitende übernehmen Sie die Steuerung und Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
In enger Kooperation mit der Agentur für Arbeit planen und leiten Sie Bewerbertage sowie Auswahlverfahren vor Ort.
Sie sprechen potenzielle Kandidaten proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle an und pflegen die Bewerberdatenbank.
Zur effizienten Vorqualifizierung und Auswahl geeigneter Bewerber – sowohl gewerblich als auch kaufmännisch – organisieren und führen Sie strukturierte Interviews.
Mit internen Stakeholdern, Personaldienstleistern sowie dem Employer-Branding-Team stehen Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit.
Um einen reibungslosen und skalierbaren Projektaufbau sicherzustellen, analysieren Sie Recruiting-Kennzahlen und optimieren die Prozesse fortlaufend.
Qualifikation
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Wirtschaftspsychologie oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung bringen Sie mit.
Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Recruiting.
Idealerweise bringen Sie zudem Kenntnisse des regionalen Arbeitsmarkts in der Supply Chain mit.
Kommunikationsstärke und Organisationstalent zeichnen Sie ebenso aus wie eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
Sprachlich überzeugen Sie mit sehr guten Deutsch- sowie guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift.

s.h: You are a “people person” and concerned about your colleagues;

s.t:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale.

With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions.

Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost.

We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

You will partner closely with our Talent Team to develop a deep understanding of our hiring needs, challenges, organizational structure, and individual team dynamics.

In this role, you will own full-cycle recruitment—from sourcing and engaging passive and active talent globally, to guiding candidates through our end-to-end hiring process, to generating offers and transitioning new hires to our People Ops Specialist for onboarding.

You will act as a key internal stakeholder, collaborating across teams to manage headcount reconciliation, oversee compensation alignment and equity, and coordinate and participate in internal interviews. You will also be responsible for ensuring recruitment projects are delivered on time and that all milestones and deliverables are met.

This role requires exceptional administrative strength , including the ability to navigate multiple documents and systems while adhering to structured, process-driven workflows.

Own and execute the Greenhouse recruiting process end-to-end, managing roles from opening through close while ensuring full process adherence.
Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date hiring documentation , tracking all candidate and hire data to support seamless reporting, audits, and data-driven decision-making.
Demonstrate exceptional organizational skills , effectively managing multiple roles, priorities, and deadlines while maintaining attention to detail throughout the day.
Provide timely, clear, and proactive updates to hiring managers and business stakeholders, anticipating needs and addressing issues before they arise.
Operate with a proactive mindset, staying one step ahead of recruiting workflows to prevent bottlenecks and ensure a smooth, efficient hiring experience.
Sourcing is a primary part of your role. You are confident in engaging passive candidates and utilizing the team’s networks to engage with candidates appropriately.

s.h: Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs
s.t:
100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Recruiting
Manage full life cycle recruiting for assigned US and Canadian requisitions: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessment administration, reference and background checks, and offer support.
Lead intake and needs analysis conversations with hiring managers to confirm role scope, must-have criteria, and hiring timeline before opening a requisition.
Partner with HRBPs to create and publish job descriptions and postings.
Source active and passive candidates using Prosci 's ATS (Workable), LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, employee referrals, and other channels.
Conduct phone screens, coordinate interview loops, administer assessments, and lead scorecard completion and debrief discussions with interview teams.
Maintain regular, high-quality communication with candidates throughout the process to protect the candidate’s experience.
Support offer construction and, in partnership with the hiring HRBP and hiring manager, help negotiate terms with candidates.
Pipeline, Compliance, and Candidate Experience
Build and maintain candidate pipelines for roles that recur or are historically difficult to fill.
Apply sourcing, screening, and interview practices consistent with Prosci 's commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, including attention to underexplored talent pools.
Apply working knowledge of US and Canadian hiring requirements relevant to recruiting (for example, pay transparency rules, background check requirements, and state or provincial variation) and flag questions to HR Business Partners rather than making independent compliance calls.
Perform select preboarding activities for new hires from the point of offer acceptance to start date, including internal stakeholder communication, coordination of first day logistics, and scheduling of week 1 core onboarding sessions.

Provide regular pipeline and hiring status updates to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Flag process friction or candidate experience issues to HR Business Partners and suggest improvements.

Full life cycle recruiting experience across sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer support, ideally spanning both US and Canadian hiring. Working knowledge of US and Canadian employment and hiring practices, with good judgment about when to escalate a compliance question (only US is required).
Working proficiency with an applicant tracking system and with LinkedIn Recruiter or an equivalent sourcing tool.
Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable managing multiple candidates, requisitions, and hiring manager relationships at once.
Ability to work independently against a defined requisition load with minimal day-to-day oversight.

5+ years of in-house or agency recruiting experience.
Demonstrated experience recruiting across a range of levels, from individual contributor through professional or exempt roles.
Experience recruiting for professional services, consulting, or other high-growth organization is a plus.
Prior contract or interim recruiting experience, comfortable ramping quickly on a new team's process and requisitions.
Experience with Predictive Index or a similar behavioral assessment tool.
Familiarity with competency-based, inclusive interviewing practices.

s.t:

Maintain timely and respectful communication with candidates and stakeholders.
Build reusable talent pipelines across Apricot’s priority roles and markets.
Keep candidate records, notes, trackers and statuses accurate and up to date.
Flag delays or hiring challenges early and recommend practical solutions.
Contribute to improving Apricot’s sourcing, screening and recruitment processes.
Use AI tools responsibly to support sourcing, research, outreach, interview preparation and administrative work.

Strong proactive sourcing, interviewing and candidate-assessment skills.
Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously.
Ability to distinguish genuine candidate quality from a strong-looking CV.

Excellent organization, follow-through and attention to detail.

Expérience dans l'élaboration et l'évaluation de stratégies RH de même que dans les domaines de la gestion des talents, de la planification de la relève et du développement du leadership
Compréhension des évolutions actuelles en matière de gestion des ressources humaines fondées sur les données et à l'aide d'outils digitaux
Connaissances approfondies de modèles de rémunération et de systèmes d'indemnisation modernes

Compétences sociales reconnues permettant de faciliter le travail en équipe et la résolution de conflits
Très bonnes connaissances de deux langues officielles et bonnes connaissances de l'anglais

Design and execute scalable yet tailored sourcing strategies at events, webinars, and conferences, acting as a brand ambassador.

Collaborate cross-functionally with the People team and business leaders to solve logistical hurdles and unblock hiring bottlenecks in a fast-changing environment.
Communicate complex recruitment findings and reporting to hiring teams, providing clarity and direction on university strategy and candidate trends.
Act as a versatile utility player, jumping in to support strategic TA initiatives whenever needed with a focus on ownership and integrity.

4+ years of experience in recruiting with specific experience in Early Careers or University Talent Acquisition.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Proven experience managing stakeholders and driving data-informed hiring decisions in a fast-paced, global tech environment.
Strong project management skills with the resilience to adapt to shifting priorities and evolving business needs.
Passion for candidate experience and a deep understanding of the unique stressors of the student job hunt.
Innovation-led mindset with a track record of identifying and implementing process improvements.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative and work autonomously on ambiguous tasks with high attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

As a Recruiter, you’ll partner with teams across EMEA, Mexico, and Brazil to attract and hire exceptional talent. As a Riot brand ambassador, you’ll deliver an inclusive, thoughtful, and high-quality candidate experience while bringing Riot’s teams, products, and player-focused mission to life. You’ll also contribute to projects and process improvements that strengthen our recruiting practices globally.
Reporting to the Supervisor, Talent Acquisition – EMEA, Mexico & Brazil, you’ll manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from developing sourcing strategies and engaging talent to partnering with hiring teams on their recruitment needs. You’ll build a strong understanding of the teams and talent markets you support, helping shape effective hiring strategies and workforce plans.
This role is based in our Dublin office and operates on a hybrid working model, combining in-office collaboration with remote work.

Manage end to end recruitment process including stakeholder management & interview coordination across all pillars and disciplines.
Build and maintain global talent pipelines , identifying candidates across multiple markets and geographies.
Develop innovative sourcing strategies using advanced Boolean search, targeted campaigns, talent communities, referrals, events, and specialist networks .
Proactively identify and engage passive talent , tailoring outreach to different roles, markets, and candidate profiles.
Partner closely with hiring managers to understand requirements, talent landscapes, and develop effective sourcing strategies.
Build trusted relationships with candidates and stakeholders, delivering a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Track sourcing and recruitment metrics to assess pipeline health, identify gaps, and continuously improve sourcing effectiveness.
Ensure recruitment activity remains efficient, compliant, and consistent across different international markets.
Champion Riot’s employer brand when engaging global technical talent, effectively communicating our opportunities, culture, and player-focused mission.

2+ years of professional recruiting experience within the games industry and/or software development.
Experience managing full-cycle recruitment, including candidate assessment, stakeholder management, onboarding, and international hiring for software engineering and other technical roles.
Strong experience in talent operations, recruitment project management, compliance, and continuous process improvement.

Experience recruiting for or supporting roles within game development.
Understanding of software development disciplines, roles, and talent profiles.
Fluency in an additional language is a plus.
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations.

Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It-s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork - every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you?

Then join our success story. Our frontline heroes are the face of Sunrise. They-re fantastic at finding customized solutions and delivering the best service - transforming every customer contact into a long-term connection.

You support customers with repair and service issues and act professionally and solution oriented. You keep track of stock and inventory and complete administrative tasks efficiently. You live and represent Sunrise values - innovation, customer focus and top service.

YOUR SKILLS: You have completed training in retail, ideally with experience in the telecommunications or multimedia industry - or you are a motivated career changer with a flair for sales. You are enthusiastic about technology, telecommunications and digital trends.

Your passion for sales is evident and your professional demeanor makes you a true sales professional. You enjoy working with people and have the ability to quickly identify their needs. Thanks to your patience and technical understanding, you will become an everyday hero for our customers.

You have very good German skills; any additional languages are a plus. You are highly flexible, reliable and open to a fast-paced industry. At Sunrise, you-ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn-t just a program for us, it-s part of our DNA.

By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance - Gender Equality in Business». We-ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Présentation du posteLe conseiller en recrutement international rapporte à la direction marketing ou à la direction de l-école BHMS, ou encore à la présidence des écoles Benedict. Il est responsable d-ouvrir de nouvelles opportunités de recrutement sur un marché international attribué - principalement en Asie ou dans d-autres régions définies - et d-atteindre des objectifs d-inscription ambitieux.

The Expert Witness Recruiter is responsible for maintaining, expanding, and strategically sourcing Dane Street ’s network of specialized expert witnesses.

This includes identifying and onboarding high-caliber experts—such as physicians, economists, biomechanical engineers, accident reconstructionists, life care planners, and ballistics experts—negotiating retention fees within pre-established guidelines, and ensuring that all open service requests (OSRs) are resolved promptly.

The ideal candidate will leverage research skills, industry networking, and strong communication to close niche talent gaps and support our legal and insurance operations.

Network Maintenance & Growth
Understand client requirements, case constraints, and turnaround time (TAT) deadlines to negotiate expert witness agreement terms.
Proactively research and source new niche specialists (e.g., engineering, financial, forensic, and scientific fields) to meet evolving client litigation needs.
Onboard new expert witnesses based on case demand, managing the collection of required documentation (curriculum vitae, specialized certifications, fee schedules, W9s, and background checks).
Maintain existing expert records, including fee schedules, profile updates, and active/inactive statuses.
Coordinate with the Director of Operations to finalize specialized fee structures.
Special Assignments & Contract Negotiations
Lead complex negotiations and contract renewals for high-priority or highly sought-after expert witnesses.
Handle sensitive or urgent client requests, particularly those involving rare specialties or tight legal discovery deadlines.
Assist expert reviewers with technical onboarding, portal training, or case-specific inquiries.
Fulfill high-priority OSRs by locating and qualifying specialized professionals, providing daily internal updates on progress.
Collaborate with operations to ensure the expert network is aligned with upcoming pipeline demand.

Support other cross-functional staffing or panel projects as assigned by leadership.
Stay current on industry trends, evidentiary standards (such as Daubert/Frye compliance), and general legal/insurance operations.

Experience
3–5 years of specialized recruiting experience, ideally within an expert network firm, litigation support agency, insurance defense firm, or legal staffing environment.
Proven track record sourcing non-traditional, highly technical roles (e.g., engineers, financial analysts, scientists).
Skills & Competencies
Strong investigative research and sourcing skills (leveraging LinkedIn, academic publications, professional associations, and industry registries).
Deep understanding of professional credentials, technical CVs, and the distinction between various scientific and technical disciplines.
Excellent negotiation, contract communication, and relationship-management skills.
Working knowledge of legal, insurance, or forensic terminology.
High proficiency in applicant tracking systems (ATS), CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office.
Working Conditions
Primarily remote with extended periods of computer work.
Occasional travel or attendance at industry conferences may be required depending on business needs.

Must supply and maintain reliable, high-speed internet.
An uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement for this role.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Duties and responsibilities may be adjusted based on evolving business needs.

## About Our Client ##
Notre client est un groupe international de premier plan évoluant dans un environnement haut de gamme, reconnu pour son savoir-faire, son exigence de qualité et son excellence opérationnelle. Ses activités en Suisse s'appuient sur des équipes multiculturelles et des sites de production combinant expertise technique, innovation et métiers à forte valeur ajoutée.
## Job Description ##
Rattaché(e) au Senior HR Business Partner, vous agissez comme partenaire RH de proximité auprès de plusieurs sites de production. Le poste implique une forte présence terrain et des déplacements quotidiens entre différents sites distants de plusieurs dizaines de kilomètres.
Vous accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours, de l'intégration au développement, et prenez en charge les situations individuelles et collectives en garantissant le respect du droit du travail suisse, des politiques internes et des processus RH.
Vous identifiez les besoins actuels et futurs en compétences et contribuez au développement des collaborateurs et des apprentis. Vous participez à la mise en place de parcours de formation permettant d'assurer la transmission durable des savoir-faire et compétences critiques.
En collaboration avec le Senior HR Business Partner, vous contribuez aux revues de talents et de succession, notamment pour les fonctions clés. Vous participez au développement du vivier de talents et collaborez avec les équipes Talent Acquisition sur les recrutements stratégiques.
Vous pilotez les principaux processus RH de votre périmètre, notamment les revues de performance, les révisions salariales et les exercices budgétaires. Vous contribuez également à la planification des effectifs en fonction des capacités de production et anticipez les besoins sur les métiers critiques ou en tension.
Vous analysez les données RH telles que les effectifs, la mobilité, l'attrition ou l'absentéisme afin d'identifier les tendances, d'anticiper les besoins et de formuler des recommandations permettant d'éclairer les décisions du management.
En véritable partenaire du business, vous conseillez les directions de sites et les managers sur leurs enjeux humains et organisationnels. Vous les accompagnez dans leurs décisions RH, les coachez dans leur posture managériale et contribuez à maintenir un environnement de travail positif et engageant.
Enfin, vous participez aux évolutions organisationnelles et aux projets de transformation de votre périmètre, en veillant à l'alignement entre les besoins opérationnels et la stratégie globale de l'organisation.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master ou d'un Brevet fédéral en Ressources Humaines et disposez d'une expérience confirmée en tant que HR Business Partner, idéalement acquise dans un environnement industriel ou de production au sein d'un groupe international.
* Vous êtes très mobile et prêt(e) à vous déplacer quotidiennement entre plusieurs sites de production, distants de plusieurs dizaines de kilomètres, afin d'assurer une présence régulière et une réelle proximité avec les équipes terrain.
* Vous possédez un excellent sens du business et savez transformer les enjeux opérationnels en solutions RH pragmatiques et à forte valeur ajoutée. À l'aise avec les données RH et les indicateurs liés aux effectifs, vous les utilisez pour soutenir la prise de décision.
* Partenaire crédible et orienté(e) solutions, vous savez conseiller, challenger et influencer des interlocuteurs de différents niveaux hiérarchiques. Vous êtes capable d'aller au-delà de l'application des processus afin de proposer des réponses adaptées aux besoins de l'organisation.
* Vous avez un réel intérêt pour le développement des personnes, la gestion des talents et la transmission des savoir-faire. Votre excellent relationnel, votre écoute active et votre intelligence situationnelle vous permettent de créer rapidement des relations de confiance.
* Vous maîtrisez le droit du travail suisse ainsi que les principaux processus RH, notamment le recrutement, la gestion de la performance et la rémunération.
* Vous parlez couramment français, possédez un bon niveau d'anglais et disposez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles. Un permis de conduire ainsi qu'une mobilité régulière entre différents sites de production sont nécessaires.
## What's on Offer ##
Vous rejoignez un environnement international, multiculturel et stimulant, dans une fonction RH stratégique bénéficiant d'une forte proximité avec les opérations et les équipes de production. Ce rôle multisite offre une grande diversité d'interlocuteurs et de problématiques, avec une présence terrain importante.
Vous travaillerez en binôme avec un(e) Senior HR Business Partner expérimenté(e), qui vous accompagnera dans votre montée en compétences et dans la gestion des sujets RH. Cette configuration est particulièrement adaptée à un profil HRBP encore junior souhaitant gagner progressivement en autonomie et en responsabilités, tout en continuant à apprendre au quotidien auprès d'un profil senior.
Le package comprend notamment des conditions de prévoyance attractives, des participations à certains frais, ainsi qu'une offre étendue de formations. Selon l'éligibilité et les contraintes liées à la présence sur les différents sites, une organisation de travail flexible peut également être proposée.
